plain_text:
Paul McGrath appears in 117 recordings across 5 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1945 to 1974. The credits here include host and performer.

In this archive, you will hear Paul McGrath most often in Inner Sanctum Mysteries, Theater Five, The Chase, Barrie Craig, and CBS Radio Mystery Theater.

Characters credited here include The Inner Sanctum Host.
